body: Zooted Zone is That Boy Hi Hat's breakout track — Black Lansky confirms the '260k streams/week' figure refers to it. The track holds 307,439 lifetime Spotify plays (observed 2026-09-14). It was produced by Kokurcho — BET Awards-nominated and RIAA-certified (Gold and multi-platinum claims both confirmed) — recorded in Hagerstown, MD in February 2023, and mixed and mastered by Hybrid at his Hagerstown, MD studio. On 2026-09-14 it was accepted onto the New Rap Hits playlist (673 followers) via Audiartist submission #25818, and a full scan of the playlist on 2026-09-15 verified it holding at position #30.
